'''Colsan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3639 BBY]] he was stationed in the [[Section X]] area of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Corporal Colsan appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a vendor in Section X, added in Update 1.5.
